75323-the-grand-fleet-1914-1916.title: Its Creation, Development And Work
75323-the-grand-fleet-1914-1916.creator: Admiral Viscount Jellicoe
75323-the-grand-fleet-1914-1916.description: A book by Admiral Viscount Jellicoe. Early in 1914, whilst serving at the Admiralty as Second Sea Lord, I had been offered and had accepted the command of the Home Fleets, which in the ordinary course would have become vacant in the following December on the expiration of Admiral Sir George Callaghan’s term of command, and public announcement was made of the intended appointment.

arxiv-1404-7400.title: THE EVALUATION OF THE SUMS OF MORE GENERAL SERIES BY
arxiv-1404-7400.creator: BERNSTEIN POLYNOMIALS
arxiv-1404-7400.description: Abstract Let n,k be the positive integers, and let S_{k}\left(n\right) be the sums of the k -th power of positive integers up to n : S_{k}\left(n\right)=\sum_{l=1}^{n}l^{k} . By means of that we consider the evaluation of the sum of more general series by Bernstein polynomials. Additionally we show the reality of our idea with some examples. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification.

arxiv-2101-12278.title: Markov dynamics on the cone of discrete Radon measures
arxiv-2101-12278.creator: Dmitri Finkelshtein, Yuri Kondratiev, Peter Kuchling
arxiv-2101-12278.description: Abstract 1 Introduction Configuration spaces form an important and actively developing area in the infinite dimensional analysis. The spaces not only contain rich mathematical structures which require non-trivial combination of continuous and combinatoric analysis, they also provide a natural mathematical framework for the applications to mathematical physics, biology, ecology, and beyond.

arxiv-2110-06505.title: POSSIBLE MODIFICATION TO STANDARD COSMOLOGICAL MODEL TO RESOLVE TENSION WITH HUBBLE CONSTANT VALUES
arxiv-2110-06505.creator: S.L. Parnovsky
arxiv-2110-06505.description: Abstract The tensions between the values of Hubble constant obtained from the early and the late Universe data pose a significant challenge to modern cosmology. Possible modifications of the flat homogeneous isotropic cosmological Λ \Lambda CDM model are considered, in which the Universe contains dark energy, cold baryonic matter and dark matter.

arxiv-2205-06993.title: Improving Neural Machine Translation of Indigenous Languages with Multilingual Transfer Learning
arxiv-2205-06993.creator: Wei-Rui Chen Muhammad Abdul-Mageed
arxiv-2205-06993.description: Abstract Machine translation (MT) involving Indigenous languages, including those possibly endangered, is challenging due to lack of sufficient parallel data. We describe an approach exploiting bilingual and multilingual pretrained MT models in a transfer learning setting to translate from Spanish to ten South American Indigenous languages.

arxiv-2208-11633.title: On a Built-in Conflict between Deep Learning and Systematic Generalization
arxiv-2208-11633.creator: Yuanpeng Li
arxiv-2208-11633.description: Abstract In this paper, we hypothesize that internal function sharing is one of the reasons to weaken o.o.d. or systematic generalization in deep learning for classification tasks. Under equivalent prediction, a model partitions an input space into multiple parts separated by boundaries.

arxiv-2211-14359.title: Grover’s Quantum Search Algorithm of Causal Multiloop Feynman Integrals.
arxiv-2211-14359.description: Abstract A proof-of-concept application of a quantum algorithm to multiloop Feynman integrals in the Loop-Tree Duality (LTD) framework is applied to a representative four-loop topology. Bootstrapping causality in the LTD formalism, is a suitable problem to address with quantum computers given the straightforward possibility to encode the two on-shell states of a propagator on the two states of a qubit.

arxiv-2302-01774.title: Poset Structure concerning Cylindric Diagrams
arxiv-2302-01774.creator: Kento Nakada, Takeshi Suzuki, Yoshitaka Toyosawa
arxiv-2302-01774.description: Abstract The purpose of the present paper is to give a realization of a cylindric diagram as a subset of root systems of type A κ − 1 ( 1 ) A_{\kappa-1}^{(1)} and several characterization of its poset structure. Furthermore, the set of order ideals of a cylindric diagram is described as a weak Bruhat interval of the Weyl group.

arxiv-2412-04328.title: The critical Karp–Sipser core of Erdős–Rényi random graphs
arxiv-2412-04328.creator: Thomas Budzinski, &, Alice Contat
arxiv-2412-04328.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Thomas Budzinski, &, Alice Contat. The Karp–Sipser algorithm consists in removing recursively the leaves as well their unique neighbours and all isolated vertices of a given graph. The remaining graph obtained when there is no leaf left is called the Karp–Sipser core. When the underlying graph is the classical sparse Erdős–Rényi random graph G ⁡ [ n , λ / n ] \mathrm{G}[n,\lambda/n] , it is known to exhibit a phase transition at λ = e \lambda=\mathrm{e} .

arxiv-2504-10260.title: Periodic Approximation of Topological Lyapunov Exponents and the Joint Spectral Radius for Cocycles of Mapping Classes of Surfaces
arxiv-2504-10260.creator: Anders Karlsson, Reza Mohammadpour
arxiv-2504-10260.description: Abstract . We study cocycles taking values in the mapping class group of closed surfaces and investigate their leading topological Lyapunov exponent. Under a natural closing property, we show that the top topological Lyapunov exponent can be approximated by periodic orbits.

arxiv-2509-01542.title: Conductive domain walls in ferroelectrics as tunable coherent THz radiation source
arxiv-2509-01542.creator: Ramaz Khomeriki 1) , Kathrin Dörr 2) , Jamal Berakdar 2)
arxiv-2509-01542.description: Abstract THz emission associated with currents in conductive domains in BiFeO 3 following infrared radiation is theoretically investigated. This experimentally observed phenomenon is explained by the domain wall stripes acting as metallic resonators with the oscillating charge accumulation being at the domain wall edges. The charge oscillation frequency is related to the plasma frequency inside the domain wall.

arxiv-2511-05152.title: Splatography: Sparse multi-view dynamic Gaussian Splatting for filmmaking challenges
arxiv-2511-05152.creator: Adrian Azzarelli, Nantheera Anantrasirichai, David R Bull
arxiv-2511-05152.description: Abstract Deformable Gaussian Splatting (GS) accomplishes photorealistic dynamic 3-D reconstruction from dense multi-view video (MVV) by learning to deform a canonical GS representation. However, in filmmaking, tight budgets can result in sparse camera configurations, which limits state-of-the-art (SotA) methods when capturing complex dynamic features.

arxiv-2602-07742.title: Gillian Debugging: Swinging Through the (Compositional Symbolic Execution) Trees, Extended Version
arxiv-2602-07742.creator: Nat Karmios, Sacha-Élie Ayoun, Philippa Gardner
arxiv-2602-07742.description: Abstract In recent years, compositional symbolic execution (CSE) tools have been growing in prominence and are becoming more and more applicable to real-world codebases. Still to this day, however, debugging the output of these tools remains difficult, even for specialist users.

europmc-pmc5916908.title: Aqueous rechargeable zinc/sodium vanadate batteries with enhanced performance from simultaneous insertion of dual carriers.
europmc-pmc5916908.creator: Wan F, Zhang L, Dai X, Wang X, Niu Z, Chen J.
europmc-pmc5916908.description: Rechargeable aqueous zinc-ion batteries are promising energy storage devices due to their high safety and low cost. However, they remain in their infancy because of the limited choice of positive electrodes with high capacity and satisfactory cycling performance. Furthermore,...

plos-pone-0006547.creator: Xiaolin Shi, Lada A. Adamic, Belle L. Tseng et al.
plos-pone-0006547.description: PLOS ONE research article. Human knowledge and innovation are recorded in two media: scholarly publication and patents. These records not only document a new scientific insight or new method developed, but they also carefully cite prior work upon which the innovation is built. We quantify the impact of inf

pmc-10628228.title: Long-term sea level rise modeling of a basin-tidal inlet system reveals sediment sinks
pmc-10628228.creator: Kevin C Hanegan, Duncan M FitzGerald, Ioannis Y Georgiou, Zoe J Hughes
pmc-10628228.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Much of the world’s population lives close to coastlines and this proximity is becoming increasingly impactful because of sea-level rise (SLR). Barrier islands and backbarrier saltmarshes, which comprise >10% of these coasts, are particularly susceptible. To better understand this risk, we model backbarrier morphologic and hydrodynamic evolution over a 200-year period of SLR, incorporating an erodible bed and a range of grain sizes.

pmc-11425686.title: The complete plastome of Rorippa palustris Besser 1821 and its phylogenetic analysis
pmc-11425686.creator: Xinhua Wang, Liqiang Wang, Jiaojiao Kong, Hongqin Li, Na Kong
pmc-11425686.description: Rorippa palustris Besser 1821, a species of Brassicaceae, is widely distributed around the world and used for both food and traditional Chinese medicinal purposes. Despite the plant’s significance, its genetic diversity must be better understood. In this study, we have successfully assembled and characterized a complete plastome of R. palustris, marking a significant advancement toward comprehending its genetic composition.

pmc-12563590.title: Healing Bodies, Healing Communities: A Community-Based Qualitative Study of Adult Survivors of Childhood Sexual Trauma in South Africa
pmc-12563590.creator: Leona Morgan, Sarojini Nadar, Ines Keygnaert, Yok-Fong Paat
pmc-12563590.description: HighlightsBody-based care models respond better to long-term, intergenerational and somatic aspects of sexual trauma in survivors being historically excluded from mental health care. Co-creation of care pathways ensures culturally sensitive approaches that are responsive to lived experiences of marginalized survivors of childhood sexual trauma. What are the main findings?

pmc-12613668.title: Diagnostic efficacy and subgroup heterogeneity of SHOX2, RASSF1A, Septin9, and HOXA9 methylation in pleural effusion lymphoma
pmc-12613668.creator: Jiaqi Bo, Zhenyao Lei, Suxia Zhang, Miaoxia He, Xinxin Huang, Bin She, Xiaosha Ren, Jie Li, Shunli Wang, Weiwei Rui, Yu Zeng, Xianghua Yi
pmc-12613668.description: BackgroundDNA methylation profiling has emerged as a promising tool for improving pathological diagnosis. This study investigates the diagnostic efficacy and subgroup heterogeneity of SHOX2, RASSF1A, Septin9, and HOXA9 methylation in pleural effusion lymphoma, aiming to enhance diagnostic accuracy and identify high-risk molecular subgroups.

pmc-12654391.title: Bioactivity and in Silico Insights of Collagen-Derived Peptides from Jellyfish (Stomolophus sp. 2) Mesoglea
pmc-12654391.creator: Blanca del Sol Villalba-Urquidy, Wilfrido Torres-Arreola, Isabel Medina, Laura Estefany Hernández-Aguirre, Jesús Enrique Chan-Higuera, Josafat Marina Ezquerra-Brauer, Wenzheng Shi, Dandan Ren
pmc-12654391.description: Jellyfish, a promising source of bioactive compounds, has attracted the attention of the biotechnology sector. This research explored the antioxidant and antimutagenic properties and the genotoxicity of peptides derived from blue cannonball jellyfish (Stomolophus sp. 2) collagen hydrolysates (JCH) as potential food supplements. Firstly, JCH was fractionated into three parts based on molecular weight.

pmc-13057069.title: Sex-specific utility of pulmonary artery metrics in predicting pulmonary hypertension and survival after TAVI: insights from advanced CT imaging
pmc-13057069.creator: Elke Boxhammer, Matthias Hammerer, Nikolaos Schörghofer, Nikolaus Clodi, Erika Prinz, Wilfried Wintersteller, Uta C. Hoppe, Klaus Hergan, Christoph Knapitsch, Bernhard Scharinger
pmc-13057069.description: ObjectivePulmonary hypertension (PH) significantly affects outcomes after transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI), with sex-specific differences indicating the need for tailored strategies. This study investigated the predictive value of CT-derived main pulmonary artery (MPA) dimensions and ratios, focusing on diagnostic accuracy and prognostic relevance in male and female TAVI patients.

pmc-13200144.title: The emotion dysregulation inventory – self-report: development and psychometric evaluation
pmc-13200144.creator: Caitlin M Conner, Lan Yu, Katharine N Zeglen, Paul A Pilkonis, Carla A Mazefsky
pmc-13200144.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundEmotion dysregulation is a transdiagnostic construct associated with multiple mental health conditions and shown to be an amenable target for treatment. The original Emotion Dysregulation Inventory (EDI) was created as a proxy-report measure validated in autistic and nonautistic youth.

pmc-13597097.title: Emergence of a genetically distinct cluster of influenza A(H3N2) viruses within subclade J.2.2 associated with hospitalization during the 2024–2025 season in Auvergne–Rhône–Alpes, France
pmc-13597097.creator: Lama Koumaty, Stéphanie Dan, Allan De Clercq, Grégory Destras, Hadrien Regue, Antoine Oblette, Adrien Le Meur, Alexandre Gaymard, Vanessa Escuret, Maude Bouscambert-Duchamp, Emmanuel Chanard, Margaux Fabre, Vincent Vieillefond, Benoit Visseaux, Antonin Bal, Laurence Josset
pmc-13597097.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). During the 2024–2025 influenza season in Auvergne–Rhône–Alpes, France, a genetically distinct cluster of A(H3N2) viruses within subclade J.2.2 was found to be significantly overrepresented in hospitalized patients compared with community patients. Circulating mainly in November and December 2024, this genetically distinct cluster harboured HA1:G62R and S145N mutations, both linked to immune escape, as well as P239Q, located near key antigenic sites and warranting further investigation.

pmc-13601059.title: Spatially Distinct Bone Marrow Sites Are Asymmetrically Impacted by Inflammatory Cardiovascular Disease
pmc-13601059.creator: Jeroen Deckers, Yuri van Elsas, Iris Versteeg, Tom Anbergen, Yohana C Toner, Cristina Grao-Roldán, Jennifer E Cole, Martin Umali, William Wang, Sheqouia Nauta, Krystyna M Demkiw, Carlos Pérez-Medina, Mandy MT van Leent, Abraham JP Teunissen, Zahi A Fayad, Leo AB Joosten, Filip K Swirski, Matthias Na
pmc-13601059.description: Visual AbstractKey words: 18F-FDG, atherosclerosis, bone marrow, immunometabolism, inflammation Inflammation is an essential process in host defense, wound healing, and the maintenance of homeostasis. Unfortunately, inflammation also drives a broad spectrum of immune-mediated pathologies, most notably cardiovascular diseases (CVD), which are markedly exacerbated by aging.
